newsitem.title: USA: Capstone Capital says names McVay CFO.
newsitem.headline: Capstone Capital says names McVay CFO.

text.p: Capstone Capital Corp said Monday it appointed Malcolm McVay as its new chief financial officer, secretary and treasurer.

McVay joins Capstone from SouthTrust Corp's SouthTrust Bank of Alabama NA, in Tuscaloosa, Alabama, where he was senior vice president and head of commercial lending activities in the Tuscaloosa market, Capstone said.

Capstone said the appointment will provide strength to its financial team and further positions the company to take advantage of the favorable market opportunities to continue growing its portfolio of hospital-based, outpatient, senior housing and other healthcare facilities.
The company's investment portfolio has grown from $166 million in 1994, the year of its initial public offering, to over $550 million today, including commitments to invest, it said.
No one was immediately available to say who McVay replaced.
